name: External Tomcat provider for exploded WAR deployment
notes: The `tomcat.external` provider runs a legacy `packaging=war` project against a user-supplied Tomcat installation. Unlike copying a WAR into `webapps/`, it writes a context descriptor into `${tomcatHome}/conf/Catalina/localhost/` whose `docBase` points at the project's exploded directory. JSP and static resource edits are therefore visible without redeployment, and the Tomcat install stays clean except for the one context file.

`tomcatHome` is a machine-specific absolute path and must live in the local layer (`.lithe/run/local.json`), never the shared project layer. `explodedPath` is workspace-relative and defaults to the Maven module directory; `contextPath` defaults to `/<name>`.

The launch plan's `executable.path` is a new absolute-path form distinct from `executable.command` (PATH lookup) and `executable.toolchain` (toolchain registry). The host resolves the platform extension (`.sh` on POSIX, `.bat` on Windows) before starting. The host also writes the context XML before start and deletes it on stop.

A `mvn war:exploded -pl <module> -am` pre-launch step regenerates the exploded directory so source changes reach Tomcat. Debug mode injects JDWP through `CATALINA_OPTS` so the Java Debug Server can attach.
